subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-11-20
html:
Weekly Pulse — Nov 20, 2026

~20 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this period (11/13→11/20), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 32 straight sessions flat.

Traffic vs last week

No change. SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, same as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No, with one housekeeping note. All 68 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 68/68 all-time (confirmed via GitHub Actions — run #68, 11-19's blog-copy overclaim fix, shipped cleanly). Backlinks flat at 2 / 1 referring domain, unchanged since 11-10's futurlabs.dev redirect loss. Domain Trust flat at 6. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured. Separately: this session found 2 commits from 11-19 (the blog-copy fix itself plus its report-archive commit) sitting on the local checkout but never pushed to origin/main — fast-forwarded and pushed before starting this week's pull; nothing was lost and no repo content caused it.

Reading the week

Two trust/GEO fixes in a row (11-16 sitewide, 11-19 blog body copy) closed out the Meta/Shopify/Stripe “connects today” overclaim family across the homepage, all 16 live page shells, and 4 blog posts — none of those connectors have shipped yet, so every surface now matches catalog.ts. That bug family is done; both content engines (connector matrix 5/5, comparison hub 5/5, blog 10 posts) remain fully built against current keyword demand, and rank, backlinks, and Domain Trust are exactly as flat as last week. The levers left to move these numbers — GSC sitemap submission, off-page Phase 1 link-building (still 0/6 registries), and configuring an AI Result Tracker LLM engine — stay human-gated.
